description: This file defines the interface for string substitution functions in the Abseil C++ library, including the Arg class, Substitute(), and SubstituteAndAppend() functions, with support for various argument types and format string validation.

classes.name: absl::substitute_internal::Arg
classes.description: A class representing an argument for substitution functions, capable of implicit conversions from various types to string views.

methods.name: absl::Substitute
methods.description: Performs string substitution based on a format string and arguments, returning the formatted string.

methods.name: absl::SubstituteAndAppend
methods.description: Performs string substitution and appends the result to an existing string.

methods.name: absl::Arg::piece
methods.description: Returns the string view of the argument.
